name: Balenberry Premium Long Wallet – 12 Card Slots, Dual Cash Pockets, Gold Zip, Mobile Storage, Wrist Strap | Unisex Long Purse
description: The Balenberry Premium Long Wallet is the perfect choice for those who want style, spaciousness and security in one wallet. This beautiful long wallet is crafted with a high-quality finish, keeping in mind all the needs of everyday use.This wallet has 12 card slots where you can easily store your ID card, ATM card, bank card, driving license and other essential cards. In addition, there are 2 large cash pockets in which you can keep notes, receipts and important documents in order.The wallet also includes 2 SIM card slots, which are perfect for storing extra SIMs. Its premium gold zipper compartment helps keep your valuables safe, while its spacious design can comfortably hold up to two mobile phones.For added convenience, there is also a half-zip pocket inside where you can store coins, keys, memory cards or other small essentials. The wrist strap provided with the wallet makes it easier and more comfortable to hold and carry.This beautiful wallet is available in two attractive colors Black and Brown and its unisex design makes it suitable for both women and men.
